profile.story: Master Example was founded in 1974 by industrial engineer Elena Rossi, who recognized a critical gap in the motorcycle safety market regarding aerodynamic stability at high speeds. Initially operating out of a small workshop in Bologna, Italy, the company focused on developing composite materials that could withstand impact while reducing weight, challenging the industry's reliance on heavy fiberglass shells. Their first major breakthrough came in 1978 with the 'AeroGuard' series, which introduced an internal suspension system designed to absorb rotational forces during a crash, setting a new standard for head protection technology.
